conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.world: same as the bowling clips: the bowler runs toward the rig's forward direction (-y); his popping crease at y=0, his stumps at y=+1.22, the batter's stumps at y=-18.9; x = bowler's left
conventions.arms: ra_ = right-arm bowler, la_ = left-arm bowler (mirror)
conventions.complete_clips: caught-and-bowled, fielding-off-own-bowling and non-striker run-out clips contain the whole run-up and action (fast-medium or off-spin), so the ball events line up with release_frame
conventions.ball: keep the ball on the bowling hand until release_frame; from catch_frame / pickup_frame it is back in the hand (left hand for the one-handed catch) until throw_release_frame
conventions.walking_back: turn_and_walk_back_to_mark -> walk_back_loop (or the polishing loop) -> arrive_at_mark_turn_ready, which ends in the same pose every bowling clip starts from

clips.note: from the end of the follow-through: turns round and walks back toward the mark (root motion ~4.2 m), ball in hand; chain into walk_back_loop
walking back to the mark, ball in the right hand
